title: Abandoned cart with no line items, no promo codes and an uncomputed totals block
rationale: An empty collection is a normal state, not an edge case - every cart starts here. Confirms the known empty-container collapse survives contact with a realistic composite document and shows what a consumer actually sees: three semantically different absences all rendered as null.
catchesBugClass: Type-erasure of empty containers into null; and, if the scheduled type-tagged-null sentinel ever lands, this proves it works on a real document rather than a one-key map.
cannotCatch: It cannot distinguish which of the three collapses is which - it asserts the aggregate. It also cannot catch the case where a container is empty at depth inside an array element.

predicted.detail: A consumer iterating line_items now has to null-guard a field the source schema declares as a non-nullable array.
